subject: Q4 Focus & Team Boundaries — Draft for Exec Cascade
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 Focus & Team Boundaries — Draft for Exec Cascade

Team —

Attached is a first-pass draft for the Q4 leadership cascade. High-level goals: tighten ownership for the inference runtime, consolidate two cross-functional squads into a single "Serving Platform" pod for reliability work, and create a small dedicated squad for private/VPC onboarding. The deliverables and expectations are in the OKR grid (sheet: ownership->metrics).

Asks:
- Please review the team_map_v2.pdf for proposed spans of control and dotted-line relationships.
- Suggest edits on OKR responsibilities in okr_grid_q4.xlsx (column: "Owner - Week 1").
- Can we get alignment by end of week so we can include this in the QBR pack?

Draft timeline:
- Sep 22: consolidate feedback
- Sep 24: finalize narrative & leader talking points
- Oct 1: cascade to managers

Key trade-offs called out in the deck: short-term throughput vs. long-term reliability investments, and temporary role dual-hatting in infra for the migration window.

Attachments: team_map_v2.pdf (PDF), okr_grid_q4.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 Focus & Team Boundaries — Draft for Exec Cascade

Rishi —

Thanks for getting this started. Quick notes inline (high level here; I'll leave cell comments in the sheet):

- Love the clearer ownership for runtime reliability. One gap: who is the escalation owner for cross-region failover? The map has it as "infra lead" but I think that needs to be a named lead for SLA accountability.
- For private/VPC onboarding squad: consider a short-term SWE+SolutionEng pairing for the first 90 days (to accelerate proofs).
- OKR phrasing: prefer "Reduce P95 end-to-end latency by 12%" rather than a generic throughput metric — customers care about tail.

I'll add proposed owner names to the OKR sheet by EOD.

On the timeline, Sep 24 feels tight for final narrative if we need to route to legal for any customer-impact language. Can we aim Sep 27 for narrative final and still hit QBR inclusion?

Onward —
Lauren
Director, Product Ops

Rishi / Lauren —

Thanks — I left a few redlines in the PDF and added examples in the OKR sheet. A couple of operational notes:

1) Hiring plan: If we merge the two squads there will be a 6-week window with overloaded ICs. I propose we allocate two contractor slots (SWE II) and convert one to FTE in Q1 if the metrics hold.
2) Communication: we should prepare a short manager FAQ (what to tell ICs, what not to commit to yet). I'll draft the FAQ and share a doc link.
3) Customer messaging: For Acme Health and BlueRiver pilots, patch releases that impact service-levels need pre-approval. We should loop in Legal on the new escalation owner and any SLA notes.

Attachments I'm adding to the drive: manager_faq_draft.md (link inside the OKR sheet).

- Monica
Senior Director, Customer Reliability

Couple of clarifications from a release and rollout perspective:

- Canary plan: We need a canary rollout for any infra changes that touch KV caching. Proposed window: Oct 10–14 with rollback gates and cost budget.
- Metrics: add synthetic traffic for the 99th percentile on the okr_grid_q4.xlsx and mark it as a gating metric for any swap of production kernels.
- Timeline: if we push the narrative final to Sep 27 (as Lauren suggested), we should still hold an internal dry-run with managers Sep 29 to catch tough questions.

I also suggest we call out a 30-day readout post-cascade to measure manager sentiment and early blocker counts.

-Jonas
VP, Engineering Operations

Question for the group: can we agree to the Sep 24 internal freeze on substantive structure changes so leaders have time to absorb before Sep 29 dry-run? If so, I'll lock the deck and start the Legal ping.

Thanks —
